landing.heroTitle: Organize Your Desires, Share Your Dreams.
landing.heroDescription: Kageo is the ultimate platform to create, manage, and share personalized wishlists for any occasion. From birthdays to holidays, make sure you get exactly what you want, and help others do the same!
landing.effortlessCreationDesc: Quickly add items with details, images, and links. Organize them by priority and status.
landing.collaborationDesc: Invite friends and family to view, suggest, or even mark items as purchased.
landing.neverMissDesc: Ensure you receive thoughtful gifts by sharing exactly what you desire.
landing.privacyDesc: Keep wishlists private or make them public for easy sharing. You're in control.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Start Your Wishlist Journey?
landing.ctaDescription: Join thousands of happy users who are simplifying their gift-giving and receiving with Kageo.

featuresPage.heroTitle: Unlock the Full Potential of Your Wishlists
featuresPage.heroDescription: Discover how Kageo makes managing your desires and coordinating gifts simpler and more fun than ever before. From effortless item tracking to seamless collaboration, we've got you covered.
featuresPage.itemManagementDesc: Add, organize, and track your desired items with intuitive tools designed for clarity and control.
featuresPage.quickAddText: Easily add items with names, descriptions, prices, and direct purchase links. Include images and notes for perfect clarity.
featuresPage.priorityText: Set priorities (low, medium, high) and track item status (wanted, reserved, purchased) to keep everyone informed.
featuresPage.sortingText: Find exactly what you're looking for with powerful sorting by name, price, or date, and filter by status or price range.
featuresPage.sharingDesc: Make gift-giving a group effort. Share your wishlists and collaborate with friends and family.
featuresPage.easyShareText: Share your wishlist link directly or send it via email. Make your list public or keep it private.
featuresPage.multiUserText: Invite collaborators with different roles (owner, editor, viewer) to manage or contribute to your wishlists.
featuresPage.privacyText: Control who sees your wishlists and items. Set individual privacy settings for each list.
featuresPage.organizeDesc: Tailor your wishlists to perfectly match your needs and style.
featuresPage.tabbedText: Easily switch between your owned wishlists and those shared with you using a clean tabbed navigation.
featuresPage.customizeText: Edit wishlist details, add cover images, and categorize your lists for better organization.
featuresPage.ownershipText: Always know who owns a wishlist, whether it's yours or shared by someone else.
featuresPage.ctaDescription: Join Kageo today and transform the way you create, manage, and share your desires.
